description: Template for the Marketing section of the book report. This section provides comprehensive marketing strategy, targeting, and promotional content.

marketing.title: Unearthing Legacy: A Marketing Blueprint for The Broken Crown
marketing.subtitle: Igniting global curiosity through royal secrets, family estrangement, and timeless betrayals.
marketing.objective: To position 'The Broken Crown' as a compelling upmarket historical fiction appealing to intellectually curious readers seeking mystery, emotional depth, and cultural richness.
marketing.keyInsight: Readers are increasingly drawn to sophisticated historical fiction that blends emotional complexity with high-stakes mystery, driven by personal discovery and systemic critique.
howToUse: Deploy teaser content featuring historical artefacts across social media channels in pre-launch.
Partner with book clubs and literary podcasts to curate themed reading experiences post-launch.
Drive awareness through suspense-heavy digital video trailers highlighting the emotional and historical stakes.
Leverage author presence through guest essays and op-eds in literary review publications and heritage blogs.
Target international literary festivals for panel participation on historical fiction and royal legacy themes.
primaryKPIs: Pre-order volumes through eBook and print listings
Engagement rate on social media campaign assets
Newsletter signup growth from teaser campaigns
Book club and reading group adoption within 6 months
Earned media coverage via literary press and heritage channels

campaignStructure.title: Campaign Funnel for Discovery, Engagement, and Loyalty

funnels.name: Awareness
funnels.description: Introduce the book’s emotional and historical intrigue through visual and thematic storytelling.
funnels.formats: Video teasers, static social tiles, podcast ads, press release and author announcements
funnels.optimisation: Focus on high CPM platforms for broad reach; A/B test historical vs. emotional hooks

funnels.name: Consideration
funnels.description: Deepen reader interest by highlighting character arcs, narrative complexity, and endorsement quotes.
funnels.formats: Carousel ads, newsletter features, author Q&As, blog partnerships, YouTube longform interviews
funnels.optimisation: Test character-led vs. theme-led narratives; optimise retargeting towards engaged clickers

funnels.name: Conversion
funnels.description: Guide readers directly to purchase through compelling calls to action on refined assets.
funnels.formats: Retargeted ads, influencer unboxings, promotional emails, Goodreads giveaways, purchase links
funnels.optimisation: Monitor ROAS on platform-specific CTAs; optimise ad spend against highest converting creative

budgetAllocation.title: Budget Spend by Campaign Phase
budgetAllocation.breakdown: 40% Awareness (video and static creatives, social boost), 35% Consideration (reviews, podcasts, influencers), 25% Conversion (retargeting, affiliate and book club deals)

flightSchedule.title: Campaign Timeline and Milestones
flightSchedule.timeline: Pre-launch: 4 weeks pre-pub; Launch: 2-week intensive promo run; Ongoing: Monthly themed engagement content for 6 months post-launch

metaTargeting.title: Meta Audience Targeting Blueprint
metaTargeting.devices: Mobile and tablet optimised with backup desktop reflow
metaTargeting.exclusions: YA audiences under 25, non-engaged users in low-literacy markets

lookaalikeAudiences.title: Lookalike Modelling Strategy
lookaalikeAudiences.refreshCadence: Quarterly refresh and suppression of lapsed interest groups
prioritisationRules: Prioritise audiences with above-average session lengths on landing pages
Preference for users interacting with historical video content

messagingFramework.title: Messaging Pillars and Audience Resonance
messagingFramework.primaryTagline: History is never truly buried. Especially when it’s made of gold.
supportingMessages: An emotionally rich quest for truth, identity, and reconciliation across generations.
A crown lost to time. A man lost in grief. One decision ties them both together.
Dive beneath royal privilege and media scandal to discover a timeless humanity.
Secrets can stay hidden for centuries—until the wrong man finds the right object.
Uncover history, restore legacy, and risk everything for the truth.

romanceReaders.title: Romantic subplots and emotional depth
romanceReaders.message: Amid gold and betrayal, find a quietly hopeful tale of reconnection, trust, and emotional repair.

bookClubs.title: Book club engagement strategy
bookClubs.message: A multi-layered narrative perfect for spirited discussion—covering history, trauma, ethics, and legacy. Includes free club reading guide.

matureReaders.title: Mature and reflective audiences
matureReaders.message: A sophisticated work that values experience, reflection, and the ache of unresolved family ties.

ruralReaders.title: Rural readers and pastoral settings
ruralReaders.message: From Wiltshire’s green fields to the fortified cities of Europe, this is a story shaped by land, memory, and the secrets buried beneath both.

sampleCopy.title: Marketing Content Samples & Templates
sampleCopy.backCoverBlurb: When Andrew Keynes unearths a glittering object in the French countryside, he doesn’t realise he’s also uncovered the past—his, his country's, and one that refuses to stay buried. As the discovery threatens to unravel royal secrets and personal ones, Andrew must battle media hysteria, legal danger, and the echoes of his late daughter’s legacy. The Broken Crown is a richly woven tale of betrayal, introspection, and reclamation—of identity, integrity, and family. What would you risk to tell the truth?

videoCreativeScripts.script: OPEN on French field. Wide aerial shot. A metal detector beeps. A glimmer in the soil. CUT TO Andrew’s startled expression. NARRATOR (V.O.): 'It was just a night walk... until he uncovered a secret worth its weight in grief.' QUICK CUTS of newspaper headlines, a courtroom, Julia turning away, the crown in shadow. NARRATOR: 'One man. One crown. A past unburied. The Broken Crown – coming soon.'
videoCreativeScripts.soraPrompt: A cinematic trailer blending historical images of a crown, contemporary scenes in France and Italy, a distressed man finding gold, whispering courtroom voices overlaid with tension-building music, ending with a shadowy close-up of a royal artefact.
